concept: The shape of content on its way, pressed into the glass where it will land, so the layout holds still when it arrives.

default_to_avoid.pattern: a grey shimmering block with a sweeping highlight (the common skeleton shimmer)
default_to_avoid.why_not: a sweeping shimmer is a moving highlight across the whole pane; a grey block owns a colour and floats on the glass

derivation.consequence: light falls from above, so every surface carries a rim brightest along its top edge and a soft shadow below that says where it floats, and a recess is the inverse, shaded under its top lip and lit on its bottom lip; a nested surface adds no second blur, because one sheet of glass is one layer
derivation.form: a skeleton is a recess, the same carve as a field, shaded under its top lip

derivation.consequence: long ease-out curves (420 to 640ms) for arriving and hovering, a shorter one (200ms) for pressing because a press is a reply; under reduced motion every duration is zero at the token level
derivation.form: it breathes slowly in opacity instead of sweeping, and stands still under reduced motion

derivation.consequence: corners are continuous and nest, so an inner surface's radius is the outer radius minus the padding between them and a pane inside a pane reads as inside it; controls are full pills because they are held in the hand
derivation.form: lines are full pills, blocks take the media corner and circles stand in for avatars

variants.reason: A sits in the glass like the field it will become (P3) and its slow breath settles (P4). B sweeps and owns a grey. C reads as an empty drop zone.

root.why: the carve of the glass where content will land, shaded under its top lip

stack.why: lines stacked with the same gap as lines of body text so the block keeps its height

text.why: a pill as tall as body text, standing in for one line

last.why: the last line is shorter, as the last line of a paragraph usually is

block.why: a rectangle with the media corner for a cover or an image

circle.why: a circle the size of an avatar for a person who is loading

@media forced-colors: active.why: forced colours fill it with the system grey text colour so it stays visible

@breathe.why: a slow breath in opacity, zero under reduced motion at the token level
